files.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Edit target: image1 is the existing oath chamber layer, with no door openings. Image2 is the approved installed B1 chamber and absolute authority for stone palette, ink masses, floor perspective and architectural scale. Image3 is a user-provided Darkest Dungeon mood reference, for darkness and selective rough ink only; do not copy its subjects or HUD. Produce ONE full frame environment painting only, no text/UI/border, 16:9 landscape. Preserve EXACT camera, vanishing point at (0.50,0.435), back-wall/floor junction around y0.62, near column footprints and the same broad floor plane of image1/image2, because independent door overlays must still fit. Preserve the oath chamber idea through a very restrained old carved frieze at upper wall level, but repaint the unnaturally factory-clean unbroken square columns and perfectly laser-straight surfaces with the sparse broad weathering and large selective ink cuts of image2. Do not add rubble piles, objects, broken small shards or tiny scratches. MOST IMPORTANT: match image2's neutral soot charcoal and grey/olive stone exactly; low saturation. Stone is GREY, never yellow sandstone/ochre/gold. Only the two small torch flames and nearby narrow inward-facing column planes are warm. Add those two lit torches in image2 locations; the base is dark and much of architecture drops into large ink-black shapes, not yellow flat ambient. Keep the central wall plain solid stone (no door!), side walls solid (no door!). Let aged masonry joints be selective uneven broad black shapes, not uniform thin clean vector seams. No extra ornament or signs. This must sit behind the exact B1 door layers without a change of material or white balance. All existing object placement ground coordinates must remain valid.
